test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

Rukmini said to Sanjana, "Why didn't you appear in the UPSC Preliminary Examination last year?"

options.text: Rukmini asked Sanjana why had she not appeared in the UPSC Preliminary Examination the previous year.
Rukmini asked Sanjana why she had not appeared in the UPSC Preliminary Examination the previous year.
Rukmini told Sanjana why she had not appeared in the UPSC Preliminary Examination the last year.
Rukmini asked Sanjana why she did not appear in the UPSC Preliminary Examination last year.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Rukmini asked Sanjana why she had not appeared in the UPSC Preliminary Examination the previous year.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Why didn’t you appear" becomes "why she had not appeared"**
 
 
• Pronoun "you" is converted to "she" to match the indirect speech.
 
• Verb "didn’t appear" is converted to "had not appeared" to match the past perfect tense in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **"last year" becomes "the previous year"**
 
 
• Time expression "last year" is converted to "the previous year" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "said to" becomes "asked" to indicate a question in indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• The sentence structure is adjusted to follow the rules of indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Rukmini asked Sanjana why she had not appeared in the UPSC Preliminary Examination the previous year."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Rukmini asked Sanjana why had she not appeared in the UPSC Preliminary Examination the previous year." 

 
 
• Incorrect word order: "had she not appeared" is not the correct form for indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Rukmini told Sanjana why she had not appeared in the UPSC Preliminary Examination the last year." 
 
 
• Incorrect reporting verb: "told" is not appropriate for a question.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Rukmini asked Sanjana why she did not appear in the UPSC Preliminary Examination last year." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "did not appear" does not match the past perfect requirement for indirect speech.
